messages:
lee: starting scheduled rollout for service-routes v3.4.0. Feature flag dynamic_route_v3 = 5% -> plan +20% every 6m to 65%. change window 02:30-04:30 UTC. pin strategy: if regress -> pin traffic to v3.3.x. docs: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.4.0 :spiral_calendar:

deploybot: [automation] deploy triggered at 1810501111. canary nodes=3. ff config dynamic_route_v3=5%. command: `/deploy service-routes v3.4.0 --canary=3 --ff dynamic_route_v3:5%`. logs streaming.

anita: watching QPS + KV hit rate. will surface any error spikes. @ops-oncall pls monitor SLOs.

ops-oncall: got it. Initial metrics look clean. KV hit=0.74, baseline 0.78, p95 +8%.

lee: hold at 25% after first bump and validate embedding cache warmup and kernel selector counts. do not cut to 65% without ack.

ci-bot: preflight checks passed: ci-e2e-llm-route ok, quant-smoke ok.

deploybot: advanced to 25% (1810501180). autoscaling health ok, rollout timer started.

anita: after bump p95 drifted to +22% and tail latency increased on GPU pool b. errors +1.2%. not ideal.

lee: hmm. per runbook prefer staged soft-off for the FF first. prepare `/ff override dynamic_route_v3 0% --reason="tail latency regression"` and keep rollback command ready.

anita: prepping soft-off command and audit note. will run if metrics don't recover in 2m.

ops-oncall: investigating GPU pool b, seeing kernel-selector fallbacks to slower path on ~40% of requests. spinning new nodes and draining pool b.

anita: executing soft-off now. `/ff override dynamic_route_v3 0% --actor=anita --note="canary tail lat spike"`.

deploybot: executed ff override (1810501225). dynamic_route_v3 removed from canary slices. audit ref: ff-xfer-9901.

anita: monitoring - tail lat back to baseline in ~70s, errors dropped. looks like kernel selector mismatch with the new binary.

lee: good. aborting further rollouts. pinning back traffic to v3.3.7. @release-ops-bot create rollback summary and link infra ticket for kernel selector investigation.

release-ops-bot: rollback summary created: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.4.0/rollback. linked INF-4210 (kernel-selector fallback on GPU pool b).

ops-oncall: recommendation: add kernel-selector sanity check to preflight and mark GPU pool b for deeper profiling.

lee: agreed. we'll add a CI check for kernel-path distribution and a short soak in staging next time. change window closed early. thanks folks. :clap:
